subject: 🎯 Stock Finder: Sun Aug 23 shortlist | THC & PLSE lead a 6-name list, GOOG position found unprotected
html_body:
🎯 Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Sunday, August 23, 2026 — Kuwait time · prices as of Friday Aug 21 close (markets closed weekend)

6 candidates cleared the gates

THC and PLSE lead — both are fresh, IBKR-confirmed breakouts to new 52-week highs on real post-earnings catalysts. TGT also broke out but is 3 days extended — wait for a pullback rather than chase it.

🚨 Account alert — checked live via IBKR during this scan

GOOG confirmed filled: 0.3 shares @ avg $368.16, now $342.15 (−2.1%, −$7.80 unrealized) — no stop-limit visible on the account. This resolves the 18-day-stale flag in portfolio.json: the GTC buy did fill and has been sitting unprotected. Place a stop-limit on it before anything else today.

AXTI / SPXC pending orders: IBKR's live-positions check shows only GOOG as an open position, which suggests these two have NOT filled — but the order-status and balance endpoints errored three times during this scan and couldn't confirm directly.

Cash available: last IBKR-verified figure was $542.01 (Aug 5), before GOOG's fill. Net of that fill (~$110.45 + ~$1 commission), estimated available cash is ≈$430 — the order plans below size off that estimate. This is an estimate, not a live balance. Run portfolio-manager to sync GOOG, confirm AXTI/SPXC status, and get the real cash figure before placing any of today's orders.

27 candidates found across 26 sources (25 web searches + 2 IBKR topic pulls). 18 got a full IBKR price/volume check. 6 cleared all 4 gates. 12 were cut — several because live IBKR data directly contradicted the bullish search narrative (see below). Cap-size mix: 3 large/mega (THC, AMGN, TGT), 1 large (CRCL), 2 small (PLSE, MATV) — small-cap side is thinner this week, noted honestly rather than padded.

Momentum Shortlist

#1 — THC Tenet Healthcare
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5) · Healthcare · Large Cap 		$279.50 +2.53%

Signal: Grinding to a fresh 52-week high today ($280.87, just $1.37 away) — 3rd straight up day. Original catalyst was the Jul 24 Q2 beat (adj. EPS $6.12 vs $4.26 expected, guidance raised to $20.30–21.69, $2B buyback added), but the stock is still making new highs a month later — clean post-earnings drift, not a one-day pop.

Price: $279.50 (IBKR live) | Avg $ vol: ~$229M/day | RS vs SPY: outperforming — up ~40% in a month vs a flat broader tape.

Realistic near-term target: +3–6% over 3-8 trading days — BofA raised its target to $295, Mizuho to $290, both just above current price.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET — not extended, sitting right at the breakout level with a clean recent low nearby.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $280.00 · stop-limit trigger $273.50 / limit $272.50 (below the Aug 21 low $274.07 and the Aug 20 close $272.60 support) · TP1 sell limit $290.00 · TP2 $296.00 · size ~0.230 shares ≈ $64 (~15% of est. $430 cash) · R:R ≈1.3:1 (TP1) / 2.1:1 (TP2)

Event window: Earnings behind it ✅. Next catalyst is Q3 earnings (~late Oct) — well clear.

Halal: ✅ Verified — pure hospital/ambulatory care operator, no insurance-underwriting segment. Defense/military: ✅ Clear.

Next step: analyze THC
#2 — PLSE Pulse Biosciences
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) · Medical Device · Small Cap 		$50.47 +5.47%

Signal: Fresh breakout to a new 52-week high today ($50.71, $0.24 away), up ~63% over the past month. Q2 earnings (Aug 6) beat estimates (-$0.284 EPS vs -$0.31 expected), the NANOPULSE-AF pivotal trial is ahead of its enrollment schedule, and three analysts initiated/raised coverage this month (Needham $58 buy, Mizuho $45, Canaccord raised $32→$43) — current price has already cleared two of those three targets.

Price: $50.47 (IBKR live) | Avg $ vol: ~$23M/day | RS vs SPY: strongly outperforming, small-cap standout.

Realistic near-term target: +9-15% over 5-10 trading days — Needham's $58 target is the only one not yet reached.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET — but this is small-cap biotech volatility, size and stop accordingly (wider stop below).

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $50.50 · stop-limit trigger $47.30 / limit $46.80 (below the Aug 21 low $47.47) · TP1 sell limit $55.00 · TP2 $58.00 (Needham target) · size ~1.277 shares ≈ $64 (~15% of est. $430 cash) · R:R ≈1.2:1 (TP1) / 2.0:1 (TP2)

Event window: Earnings behind it ✅. NANOPULSE-AF trial enrollment target is early Q4 2026 — a forward milestone to watch, not a binary FDA date; this is a technical/earnings-driven trade, not a catalyst bet.

Halal: ✅ Verified — bioelectric medicine (pulsed field ablation device). Defense/military: ✅ Clear.

Next step: analyze PLSE
#3 — AMGN Amgen
⭐⭐⭐ (3/5) · Biopharma · Mega Cap 		$439.05 +1.82%

Signal: Sitting right at its 52-week high ($443.20, just $4.15 away), up 30% YTD on a Q2 earnings beat and raised full-year guidance. Low-volatility mega-cap grind, not a sharp spike — the safest/steadiest of today's names, with the least room to run.

Price: $439.05 (IBKR live) | Avg $ vol: ~$929M/day | RS vs SPY: outperforming, steady uptrend.

Realistic near-term target: +4-6% over 5-10 trading days — modest, consistent with mega-cap post-earnings drift.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET — near highs but not chasing a spike, this is a grind.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $439.00 · stop-limit trigger $430.50 / limit $429.50 (below the Aug 20 low $431.07) · TP1 sell limit $455.00 · TP2 $465.00 · size ~0.147 shares ≈ $65 (~15% of est. $430 cash) · R:R ≈1.7:1 (TP1) / 2.7:1 (TP2)

Event window: Earnings behind it ✅. No imminent binary catalyst known.

Halal: ✅ Verified — biopharmaceuticals. Defense/military: ✅ Clear.

Next step: analyze AMGN
#4 — TGT Target Corp
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5 momentum) · Retail · Large Cap 		$165.35 +4.49%

Signal: Genuine fresh 52-week high today ($165.48) on a Q2 beat with multiple analyst target hikes (Telsey $182, Goldman $161, Guggenheim $150→$175). But this is the 3rd straight strong up-day off the earnings gap with no pullback yet — chasing here gives a mediocre R:R.

Price: $165.35 (IBKR live) | Avg $ vol: ~$1.03B/day | RS vs SPY: strongly outperforming.

Entry read: WAIT FOR PULLBACK to $160.00–161.00 (the Aug 20 close / Aug 21 low zone) — do not chase at $165. Correct thesis, but the entry needs patience.

Order plan (GTC, on pullback fill only): BUY limit $160.50 · stop-limit trigger $153.80 / limit $153.00 (below the Aug 20 low $154.50) · TP1 sell limit $168.00 · TP2 $172.00 · size ~0.402 shares ≈ $65 (~15% of est. $430 cash) · R:R ≈1.0:1 (TP1) / 1.5:1 (TP2)

Event window: Earnings behind it ✅.

Halal: ✅ Verified — general merchandise retailer; wine/beer sales are incidental to a general retailer, not the core business. Defense/military: ✅ Clear.

Next step: analyze TGT
#5 — CRCL Circle Internet Group
⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5 momentum) · Fintech/Stablecoins · Large Cap 		$88.55 +5.85%

Signal: The freshest, strongest momentum in today's scan — 3 straight days of ~6%+ gains (up from $62 to $88, +42% in a month), riding a broad crypto-sector rally plus its own Sept 16 Arc Layer-1 blockchain launch date. Huge liquidity, real acceleration.

Price: $88.55 (IBKR live) | Avg $ vol: ~$2.3B/day | RS vs SPY: sharply outperforming.

⚠️ Halal — flag, not a clean pass: Circle's core revenue line, per its public filings, is interest income earned on the Treasury reserves backing USDC — that's structurally different from a normal operating company holding incidental cash. This may sit closer to "interest-based finance" than a fee-for-service fintech. Your halal screen is business-activity only and this is your call, but it deserves a harder look before entering, not a rubber-stamp ✅.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET on the momentum — but resolve the halal question first.

Order plan (GTC, IF you clear the halal question): BUY limit $88.50 · stop-limit trigger $86.00 / limit $85.30 (below Friday's low $86.36) · TP1 sell limit $93.50 · TP2 $98.00 · size ~0.729 shares ≈ $65 (~15% of est. $430 cash) · R:R ≈1.6:1 (TP1) / 2.8:1 (TP2)

Event window: Arc blockchain launch dated Sept 16 — could be a positive catalyst or a sell-the-news risk. If holding into it, treat that as a hard time-stop checkpoint.

Defense/military: ✅ Clear.

Next step: analyze CRCL
#6 — MATV Mativ Holdings
⭐⭐⭐ (3/5) · Specialty Materials · Small Cap 		$12.47 +3.92%

Signal: Earnings beat (cost discipline, FCF +24%) drove a run from $7.85 to $12.89 (Aug 11), and it's been consolidating 12.00-12.50 for two weeks — today's bounce is off that base, not a fresh breakout. Weakest signal of the six, included for honest cap-size balance rather than padding.

Price: $12.47 (IBKR live) | Avg $ vol: ~$5M/day today (90-day average unavailable from this scan — confirm before entering; this is thin) | RS vs SPY: outperforming.

Realistic near-term target: +8-16% if it breaks the 2-week base and the older 52-week high ($15.24) comes into play.

Entry read: BUY AT MARKET, small size only, given the liquidity caveat.

Order plan (GTC): BUY limit $12.50 · stop-limit trigger $11.90 / limit $11.75 (below the recent consolidation lows) · TP1 sell limit $13.50 · TP2 $14.50 · size ~5.160 shares ≈ $65 (~15% of est. $430 cash) · R:R ≈1.3:1 (TP1) / 2.7:1 (TP2)

Sizing note: ~$2 round-trip commission on a $65 position is ~3.1% — targets above comfortably clear that, but it's worth knowing going in.

Halal: ✅ Verified — filtration media, tapes, release liners (industrial materials). Defense/military: ✅ Clear.

Next step: analyze MATV

Cut this run — 12 dropped, showing the work

SMCI — FADED: search cited a +7.5% earnings pop, IBKR shows only +2.0% today (37% off 52w high); initial pop already reversed on a Netlist patent-litigation overhang plus FY27 guidance implying ~700bps margin compression.
CVLT — MISLEADING SEARCH FRAME: "+24.86% in August" ignores that IBKR's own price history shows a -19.7% one-day crash Jul 28, a peak of $151.10 on Aug 13, then an 11% decline since — today's +2.07% is a small bounce inside a downtrend, not a breakout.
DIOD — CHOPPY/UNCONFIRMED: ran $76→$107.56 (Aug 18) then reversed hard to $90.74 (Aug 20); today's +3.64% is one day of recovery attempt, too early to call the trend resumed.
CIEN — STALE: 38% off its 52w high, only +1.28% today; the $500 analyst target isn't producing fresh price action right now.
NVTS — STALE: flat today (+0.08%), no live signal despite the "+91% YTD" framing.
DUOL — FADED vs IBKR: down -0.86% today, 59% off its 52w high ($353) — already trading through the analyst's $160 target, contradicts the bullish "upgrade" framing.
ACVA — FADED vs IBKR: down -3.13% today despite a "unusual call activity" search hit — live price action is bearish, not bullish.
AAPL — STALE: down -0.52% today; the analyst target raise is over a week old and isn't producing an active signal (Gate 1 requires live momentum, not just a standing upgrade).
TPG — HALAL-AMBIGUOUS: real momentum (+1.6% today, earnings beat, $16B capital raise), but TPG Credit is a major platform ($200B+ deployed since inception) actively raising new private-credit funds — couldn't cleanly confirm this clears the "no interest-based finance" screen without a deeper look, so held back rather than passed through.
OKTA — DATA UNAVAILABLE: IBKR returned a stale, zero-volume snapshot — couldn't confirm today's signal live, excluded on caution rather than passed on stale numbers.
ABCL — DATA UNAVAILABLE: same issue, stale zero-volume snapshot.
NP (Neptune Insurance) & AXON — hard-excluded before Phase 2: NP is a conventional insurer (halal exclusion); AXON's core product is conducted-energy weapons (tasers) — fails the weapons-manufacturing exclusion regardless of the law-enforcement-vs-military distinction.

Today's best setup

THC — Tenet Healthcare. The cleanest combination on the board today: a genuine fresh breakout to new highs, a real earnings-and-guidance catalyst that's a month old and still driving price (not a one-day pop), no halal ambiguity, and strong liquidity. PLSE has the better raw % setup but carries small-cap biotech volatility; CRCL has the freshest momentum but an unresolved halal flag. THC is the one that's clean on every axis at once.

Invalidation: a close back below $272.60 (the Aug 20 close, just under the breakout base) — that's the level that says this thesis is wrong, not a percentage guess.

How to use this

1. Fix the GOOG stop first — that's not optional.
2. Run portfolio-manager to confirm AXTI/SPXC status and get real available cash before sizing anything below.
3. Pick 1-2 names that interest you, run analyze [TICKER] for the full deep dive before placing anything.
4. This shortlist is a first filter, not a green light on its own.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Verify halal compliance on your own standard before entering, especially CRCL and TPG flagged above. Generated Sunday, August 23, 2026 — Kuwait time.
